# Current Connect4 solver archive

Extract [iteathen-isomax-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz](iteathen-isomax-0.2.0-rc.2.tgz), keep
the complete `package/` folder, then run `node verify.mjs` and `node run.mjs` there.
No installation or submodule is needed.

[SHA256SUMS](SHA256SUMS) identifies the exact unchanged producer archive.
[VERIFICATION-0.2.0-rc.2.json](VERIFICATION-0.2.0-rc.2.json) records its original
qualification. These identities do not change when the package is transferred
to Connect4. Earlier Connect4 source and evidence remain in Git history.
